name: Domain For Sale – Sell Domains with Landing Pages, Offers & Inquiries
author: ThemeAtelier

sections.description:
Domain For Sale is a WordPress plugin that lets you create professional domain for sale landing pages and sell unused domains directly from your website. Accept domain offers and inquiries, manage negotiations, and handle domain sales entirely from your WordPress dashboard—without relying on third-party marketplaces.

With Domain For Sale, you can showcase domains using customizable landing page templates and built-in offer forms. Buyers can submit offers or inquiries directly, while you manage all submissions from a centralized offer management dashboard inside WordPress. Perfect for domain investors who want full control over offers, negotiations, and buyer communication in one place.

Each offer includes detailed buyer information such as contact details, offer amount, proposal message, and submission context, helping you evaluate leads with confidence. Automatic email notifications keep both admins and buyers informed at every stage, with customizable templates for a professional sales experience.

Use the plugin as a full domain sale theme replacement or embed domain listings anywhere using shortcodes. Domain For Sale works with any WordPress theme and supports Gutenberg, Elementor, and popular page builders. Fully responsive layouts ensure your domain sale pages look great on all devices.

Designed for domain investors, agencies, and website owners, Domain For Sale offers a simple interface for beginners and flexible customization options for advanced users. Regular updates, multisite support, and clear documentation make it easy to manage multiple domain listings at scale.

Turn your unused domains into opportunities with Domain For Sale — a flexible WordPress plugin to sell domains with landing pages, offers, and inquiries.

👁️Plugin Demo | 🚀Pro Version | 📖Documentation | 👩🏼‍💻Support | 🌟Rate this plugin

Video demo

Key Features of Domain For Sale:

  • Domain For Sale Landing Pages – Create a professional domain for sale landing page to sell unused domains directly from your WordPress site.

  • Unlimited Domain Templates – Create and manage unlimited domain sale templates using a dedicated custom post type.

  • Flexible Display Options – Use the plugin as a full theme replacement or embed domain sale pages anywhere using shortcodes.

  • Built-in Offer & Inquiry Form – Allow buyers to submit domain offers and inquiries directly from your domain sale pages.

  • Centralized Offer Management Dashboard – View, search, filter, and manage all incoming domain offers from one place inside WordPress.

  • Detailed Offer & Buyer Information – Each offer includes buyer name, email, phone number, offer/proposal message, domain name, date, and submission context.

  • Automatic Admin Email Notifications – Receive instant email notifications when a new domain offer or inquiry is submitted.

  • Bidder Confirmation Emails – Automatically send confirmation emails to buyers after they submit an offer.

  • Customizable Email Templates – Customize admin and bidder email subjects and messages using dynamic tags such as {domain}, {name}, {email}, {phone}, {offer}, {proposal}, {date}, {siteTitle}, {currentURL}.

  • Price Display Options – Display domain prices using dynamic placeholders like {price} or {{price}}.

  • Currency Selection – Choose your preferred currency for displaying domain prices.

  • Responsive & Mobile-Friendly Design – Domain sale pages automatically adapt to desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

  • Pre-Designed Layouts – Choose from ready-made layouts to quickly launch professional domain sale pages.

  • Advanced Design Controls – Customize container width, column spacing, background images, overlays, and color schemes without coding.

  • Typography Controls – Control fonts, sizes, colors, line height, and text styles for domain names, titles, content, and forms.

  • Multiple Color Schemes – Select from predefined color schemes to match your brand instantly.

  • Custom Contact Information Blocks – Add multiple contact details such as email addresses and phone numbers with icons.

  • AJAX-Powered Forms – Fast, smooth form submissions without page reloads.

  • Custom Success & Error Messages – Customize form success messages, error messages, and button labels.

  • Custom CSS & JavaScript Panels – Add your own CSS or JavaScript directly from the plugin settings.

  • SEO-Friendly Structure – Clean markup and lightweight output designed to work well with SEO plugins.

  • Page Builder Compatibility – Works seamlessly with Gutenberg, Elementor, Classic Editor, WPBakery, Divi, Beaver Builder, Bricks, Oxygen, and more.

  • Theme-Agnostic – Compatible with all WordPress themes including Astra, Blocksy, Kadence, Neve, OceanWP, Avada, and Divi.

  • Multilingual & RTL Ready – Translation-ready and compatible with WPML, Polylang, Loco Translate, and RTL languages.

  • Multisite Compatible – Fully functional in WordPress Multisite environments.

  • Backup & Restore Settings – Export and reuse plugin settings across multiple websites.

  • No Coding Required – Beginner-friendly UI—install, activate, create a domain template, and start receiving offers.

  • Developer-Friendly Architecture – Clean, extensible codebase suitable for customization and advanced use cases.

  • Cross-Browser Compatibility – Works smoothly on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and Opera.

  • Comprehensive Documentation – Step-by-step guides and tutorials for easy setup and usage.

  • Regular Updates & Active Support – Ongoing improvements, security updates, and responsive support.

sections.installation:
AUTOMATIC INSTALLATION (EASIEST WAY)

  • Visit Plugins > Add New.
  • Search for Domain For Sale.
  • Install and activate the Domain For Sale plugin.

MANUAL INSTALLATION

Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  • Download domain-for-sale.zip
  • Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  • Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  • Select domain-for-sale.zip from your computer
  • Click ‘Install Now’
  • Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

Using FTP

  • Download domain-for-sale.zip
  • Extract the domain-for-sale folder to your computer
  • Upload the domain-for-sale folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  • Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

After activation

  • Go ‘Domain For Sale’ Menu from the left panel of admin
  • Configure settings as you want.

For basic usage, have a look at Domain For Sale quick start guide
sections.faq:
Who should use Domain For Sale?

Domain For Sale is ideal for domain owners, investors, agencies, and businesses who want to create a professional domain for sale landing page and receive offers or inquiries directly through their WordPress website.

Do I need coding skills to use Domain For Sale?

No coding skills are required. The plugin provides a user-friendly interface with visual controls and simple settings to create and manage domain sale pages.

Is Domain For Sale responsive?

Yes. All Domain For Sale layouts are fully responsive and automatically adapt to desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

Can I add a domain for sale page anywhere on my website?

Yes. You can display domain sale layouts using shortcodes, Gutenberg blocks, or Elementor widgets, allowing you to place them on any page or post.

Can I create multiple domain sale layouts with different settings?

Yes. You can create multiple domain layouts, each with its own design, content, and configuration options.

Will Domain For Sale work with my WordPress theme?

Yes. Domain For Sale works with most modern WordPress themes that follow WordPress coding standards and does not rely on theme-specific functionality.

How can buyers contact me about purchasing a domain?

Interested buyers can submit offers or inquiries using the built-in form. All submissions are stored in the Offers section of the plugin, and email notifications can be enabled. You may also display your email address or phone number on the page for direct contact.

Can I use Domain For Sale for commercial purposes?

Yes. Domain For Sale is free to use for both personal and commercial projects.

I configured everything correctly, but I am not receiving emails. Why?

Some hosting providers restrict the default PHP mail function. To improve email delivery, we recommend using an SMTP plugin such as WP Mail SMTP or Fluent SMTP.

Is Domain For Sale multilingual ready?

Yes. Domain For Sale is translation-ready and works with popular multilingual plugins such as WPML, Polylang, GTranslate, Loco Translate, and WPGlobus.

Is Domain For Sale compatible with WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Domain For Sale is fully compatible with WordPress Multisite environments.

How can I get support?

You can ask questions or report issues in the official WordPress.org support forum:
https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/domain-for-sale/

I have suggestions or feature requests. How can I share them?

We welcome feedback and suggestions. You can share ideas or report bugs through the support forum. We actively review user feedback to improve the plugin.

I want more features. Is there a Pro version available?

Yes. A Pro version of Domain For Sale is available and includes additional features and enhancements. You can learn more on the official website:
https://wpdomainforsale.com/pricing/?ref=1
